analysis:
Examined all supplied workflow excerpts, documentation patches and file metadata. The visible CI changes restore daily .git caches, reject connectivity-damaged repositories, disable checkout credential persistence, and condition saves on SAVE_CACHES (.github/workflows/ci.yml:669–696, 1008–1035, 1070–1097). Actions remain commit-pinned. No supported attacker-controlled cache writer or token disclosure is established. Git fsck checks object connectivity, not configuration/hook provenance; security therefore depends on the save-side trust restriction and cache isolation.

Cluster metadata keys retain toolchain, manifest, submodule pin and path inputs while dropping describe text (ci.yml:916–922); cached timestamp restoration remains delegated to scripts/provider-release-cache.py (:931–939). Coverage exports and upload (:554–650) expose source coverage, not visible prompts, keys or attestation evidence. The SDK and GPU nonblocking policies and Provider Tests gate are unchanged according to the range map; they are not new regressions.

Docs Impact adds partial/sparse checkout (.github/workflows/docs-impact.yml:61–68) without changing permissions, signature verification or validation commands. No evidence shows excluded archives/videos are required for a security check. Documentation describes branch-restricted saves, runner-cache isolation, and push routing admission (docs/developer/build.md patch at head:269–273, 295–378); these assertions are not independent enforcement evidence.

Relevant model contracts are build integrity/qualification (A-011, A-017, T-013, T-034, T-054) and native/cache test coverage (TB-007, T-041). No serving authorization, inference encryption, billing, privileged helper or cache-payload control changes appear here. Integration must reconcile the new save-caches input with .github/actions/provider-ci-build/action.yml, verify cache/timestamp compatibility in the changed helpers, and verify SAVE_CACHES and push-routing enforcement in the other source units. Those implementations are outside this local excerpt; this is not a full-PR clearance.
